lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: Right, ferryman — let's go through the books, shall we? See how much you owe me to date. So we don't end up bickering about it again.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Let's go through them, Hermes. Better to have it settled. Saves trouble.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: One anchor, picked up per your order: five drachmas.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: By Hades himself, five is what I paid. Plus an oar-strap, two obols.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Put down five drachmas two obols.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: And a patching-needle for the sail. Five obols, out of my own pocket.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: And wax — to plug the gaps in that little tub of yours — plus nails, plus the bit of rope you turned into the upper brace. Two drachmas, the lot.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: That's everything, unless we've missed something. [pause] So. When were you planning to settle up?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Right now? Impossible, Hermes. But if a plague comes through, or a war sends down a decent batch all at once — then there's a bit to be skimmed, fiddling the fares.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: So my plan, then, is to sit here praying for catastrophe. On the off chance I get my money back.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: No other way, Hermes. Right now, as you can see — trickle. Peacetime.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: [dry] Lovely. Glad the world's at peace. And meanwhile you string me along on the debt. [pause] You know, Charon, the old-timers — they used to arrive in proper shape. Brave men, every one of them, drenched in blood, most of them carrying wounds. Now? Either he's been poisoned by his son, or by his wife, or he's bloated his belly and his legs to bursting on luxury. Pale, the whole lot of them. Soft. Nothing like the old breed. And most of them come down here over money — plotting against each other, by the look of it.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: Then I trust no one'll blame me for pressing hard to collect what's mine.
